card.blocksHint: the windows subscription limits are counted in
card.toolsHint: cost of the API calls that invoked each tool (split evenly)
card.guardLogHint: what the hook stopped before it burned tokens
card.libraryHint: ready-made agents, one click to install
card.pricesHint: $ per 1M tokens · override in config.json → pricing
split.hitGood: Cache hit {pct} — great, context is being reused.
split.hitBad: Cache hit {pct} — context is often re-written to cache. Fewer idle gaps and /compact help.
guard.empty: Nothing yet. Install Guard in Settings.
ag.empty: No agents yet — add some from the library or create your own.
ed.title: Agent: {id}
ed.hint: name and description are required. The description decides when Claude delegates to the agent.
int.other: Another statusline is set: {cmd} — ClaudePlus keeps it and restores it on uninstall.
int.file: File: {file}. A backup is saved to ~/.claudeplus/backups before every change. Open a new Claude Code session afterwards.
int.done: Done. Open a new Claude Code session.
b.stop: Hard stop: Guard blocks tools once the daily limit is reached
g.block: block — deny once (an identical retry goes through)
g.warn: warn — let it run, but warn Claude
g.noisy: Catch noisy commands (ls -R, git log without a limit, logs…)
g.maxKb: Max size of a full file read, KB
demo.banner: Demo mode — synthetic data. Run `cplus dash` to see your own.
leak.cache-rebuild.title: Cache rebuilt after idle gaps
leak.cache-rebuild.detail: {count} times the whole context was written to cache again after a pause (the cache lives 5 min or 1 h).
leak.cache-rebuild.advice: Run /compact before a break, or start the next task with /clear. Long sessions with pauses are the most expensive pattern.
leak.heavy-context.title: Oversized context (>200k tokens)
leak.heavy-context.detail: {count} calls ran with more than 200k tokens of context. Every one of them re-reads the whole context.
leak.heavy-context.advice: Use /compact around 150k, split big tasks into separate sessions, push exploration into subagents.
leak.premium-subagents.title: Subagents on premium models
leak.premium-subagents.detail: Subagents spent {cost} on Opus/Fable. On Sonnet 5.5 the same work would have cost {savings} less.
leak.premium-subagents.advice: Give search/read agents `model: sonnet` or `model: haiku` (cplus agents model <name> haiku, or the Agents tab).
leak.duplicate-reads.title: Same file read again and again
leak.duplicate-reads.detail: {count} extra full reads of unchanged files (~{tokens} tokens pushed into context).
leak.duplicate-reads.advice: Turn on ClaudePlus Guard (cplus install --guard): it tells Claude the file hasn't changed since the last read.
leak.big-outputs.title: Giant tool outputs
leak.big-outputs.advice: Read files in slices (offset/limit), cap command output (| head, --quiet), search with Grep instead of cat.
leak.thinking.title: Thinking share of output tokens
leak.thinking.detail: {pct} of output tokens are thinking. That's normal for hard tasks.
leak.thinking.advice: For routine work (renames, small edits) lower the effort: /effort low or medium.
